workflow remote
===============

Synopsis
""""""""

**workflow remote** <*action*> ...

Description
""""""""""""

Registers and configures remote systems for synchronization and job execution.

Arguments
""""""""""

<*action*>
    Can be any of the following:

    * :doc:`add <add>`
    * :doc:`setup <setup>`

   :maxdepth: 1
   :hidden:
